process_area.title: Acquirer, PSP & Payment Partner Lifecycle Management

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, IT, Store Ops, Finance
fields.Trigger: New store opening, new tender type, or acquirer expansion
fields.Volume: 200 stores × ~4 acquirer relationships (BDO, BPI, Metrobank, Chinabank)

workflows.name: Acquirer & Card Scheme Registration, MID/MCC Setup

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-submit of "submits merchant application to acquiring bank per entity/location" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "IT configures terminal profiles" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates test transactions" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Onboarding risk**: Incomplete KYC/permit docs delay store opening; mitigated by 8-week pre-opening checklist
System Touchpoints: - POS terminal management system; acquirer onboarding portal; merchant master

steps.activity: Payment Ops Manager submits merchant application to acquiring bank per entity/location; provides SEC docs, BIR 2303, mayor's permit, store photos; specifies MID and MCC
IT configures terminal profiles (Visa/Mastercard/JCB/UnionPay/BancNet accept marks), MID/TID, and settlement routing in POS terminal management system
Payment Ops Manager validates test transactions (live + reversal) end-to-end before go-live; archives acquirer confirmation and fee schedule

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, Ecommerce, IT, Finance
fields.Trigger: New e-wallet partner or store enablement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "accounts with GCash/Maya per entity" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "IT integrates e-wallet API with POS" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "Finance validates daily settlement files" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-469 (ensure controlled execution — Acquirer, PSP & Payment Partner Lifecycle Management (PA-80.1).)
- operational: fallback to manual QR + status reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Operational risk**: QR/payment-intent API downtime causes checkout failure; mitigated by fallback to manual QR + status reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - E-wallet merchant portal; POS QR/intent integration; daily settlement file ingestion

steps.activity: Payment Ops Manager registers merchant accounts with GCash/Maya per entity; configures dynamic QR, merchant-intent API, and cash-in/cash-out capability
IT integrates e-wallet API with POS (QR generation, payment notification callback, status polling) and ecommerce checkout; certifies sandbox testing
Finance validates daily settlement files (DCS) vs. POS capture; reconciles e-wallet fee deductions (1.5–2%) and rebates; archives partner agreements

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, IT Security, Ecommerce, Treasury
fields.Trigger: Gateway onboarding, key expiry, or security event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "Ecommerce integrates gateway into checkout" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "Payment Ops Manager rotates keys annually and post-incident" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-469 (ensure controlled execution — Acquirer, PSP & Payment Partner Lifecycle Management (PA-80.1).)
- operational: vault-managed keys and quarterly access review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Key compromise enables fraudulent refunds/charges; mitigated by vault-managed keys and quarterly access review
System Touchpoints: - Secrets vault; gateway merchant console; PCI-DSS scope tracker
Time Estimate: - 2–4 hours per rotation; 1–2 weeks per gateway integration

steps.activity: IT Security provisions API keys, webhook secrets, and merchant credentials in secrets vault; configures 3-D Secure (3DS) for card-not-present; scopes tokens per channel
Ecommerce integrates gateway into checkout (redirect, direct, or hosted fields); configures payment method routing and fallback; tests in sandbox
Payment Ops Manager rotates keys annually and post-incident; coordinates zero-downtime cutover; archives key inventory and PCI-DSS scope attestation

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, Category Manager, IT, Finance
fields.Volume: ~3–4 BNPL partners; significant for appliance/category sales

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discount rate split" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "IT integrates BNPL approval API at POS/checkout" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks separate settlement timing" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-469 (ensure controlled execution — Acquirer, PSP & Payment Partner Lifecycle Management (PA-80.1).)
- operational: dedicated clearing GL and daily reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation risk**: BNPL net settlement vs. gross sale timing mismatch; mitigated by dedicated clearing GL and daily reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - BNPL partner API; POS approval flow; settlement reconciliation workspace

steps.activity: Category Manager negotiates BNPL placement on appliance/category SKUs; defines commission/discount rate split (typically 4–8% MDR-equivalent)
IT integrates BNPL approval API at POS/checkout; cashier triggers application; receives instant approval/decline; captures reference
Finance reconciles BNPL settlement (full amount minus partner fee, net of refunds/chargebacks) to POS sales; tracks separate settlement timing (T+1 to T+3)

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, Finance, Category Manager
fields.Trigger: Annual fee review or new category rollout

workflows.name: Merchant Category Code (MCC) Optimization & Interchange Classification

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates MCC assignment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyzes effective MDR by scheme/tier" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks interchange/regulatory fee changes" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-469 (ensure controlled execution — Acquirer, PSP & Payment Partner Lifecycle Management (PA-80.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Wrong MCC inflates interchange (e.g., consumer vs. commercial pricing); mitigated by annual validation
System Touchpoints: - Acquirer fee schedule; MCC master; MDR analytics dashboard

steps.activity: Payment Ops Manager validates MCC assignment (e.g., 5200 Lumber/Building Materials, 5712 Furniture, 7623 Appliance Repair) per store/profile; corrects mis-classification
Finance analyzes effective MDR by scheme/tier; benchmarks vs. market (1.5–3% blended); negotiates volume-based reductions and scheme incentive programs
Payment Ops Manager tracks interchange/regulatory fee changes (BSP rate caps, scheme updates); updates settlement expectation and GL accruals

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Treasury

workflows.name: Payment Partner SLA, Pricing & MDR Contract Review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepares partner performance dossier" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews SLA/penalty/liability clauses" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates first settlement cycle against revised schedule" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-469 (ensure controlled execution — Acquirer, PSP & Payment Partner Lifecycle Management (PA-80.1).)
- operational: annual benchmarking and competitive RFP
Pain Points / Risks: - **Commercial risk**: Suboptimal pricing on 2.8M transactions/month is material; mitigated by annual benchmarking and competitive RFP
System Touchpoints: - Settlement engine pricing master; contract repository; SLA monitoring

steps.activity: Finance prepares partner performance dossier: transaction volume, uptime, decline rate, dispute ratio, effective cost; benchmarks against alternatives
Procurement leads commercial negotiation (MDR, per-txn fixed fee, settlement timing, chargeback fee); Legal reviews SLA/penalty/liability clauses
Treasury/Payment Ops Manager executes contract; configures new pricing in settlement engine; validates first settlement cycle against revised schedule

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, IT, Store Ops, Finance, BCM

workflows.name: Payment Partner Offboarding & Business Continuity Cutover

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinates dual-running window" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "IT executes terminal profile updates in waves" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Finance closes old partner GL accounts" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-469 (ensure controlled execution — Acquirer, PSP & Payment Partner Lifecycle Management (PA-80.1).)
- operational: dual-running window and rollback plan
Pain Points / Risks: - **Continuity risk**: Cutover gap causes tender outage at POS; mitigated by dual-running window and rollback plan
System Touchpoints: - Terminal management system; settlement reconciliation; BCM runbook

steps.activity: Payment Ops Manager plans offboarding timeline with replacement partner onboarding; coordinates dual-running window; notifies card schemes and terminals of MID change
IT executes terminal profile updates in waves; tests fallback routing; ensures in-flight settlements and pending disputes are mapped to new partner
Finance closes old partner GL accounts; reconciles final settlement and reserves; archives documentation; updates BCM runbook with lesson learned

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, Finance, Master Data
fields.Trigger: New entity, new partner, or restructure

workflows.name: Multi-Entity Merchant Settlement Hierarchy & GL Mapping

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates uniqueness and completeness" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-post of "Finance configures per-entity settlement GL posting rules" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "file across all entities" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: annual integrity test and segregation controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation risk**: Mis-mapped MID causes wrong-entity revenue recognition; mitigated by annual integrity test and segregation controls
System Touchpoints: - Settlement hierarchy master; GL posting rules; intercompany clearing engine

steps.activity: Master Data maintains settlement hierarchy mapping MID/Partner/Entity to GL clearing, fee, and bank settlement accounts; validates uniqueness and completeness
Finance configures per-entity settlement GL posting rules; ensures intercompany clearing for cross-entity transactions (e.g., Digital Commerce collects, Depot fulfills)
Payment Ops Manager runs annual integrity test: simulate settlement file across all entities; verify GL postings and bank credits reconcile to expected
